The Steam Spring Sale 2025 is here, and First Break Labs is bringing some incredible deals on our games! Whether you're into roguelike bullet hells, Lovecraftian dungeon crawlers, or chaotic couch co-ops, we've got something for you—all at a discount!

🌊 Cthulhu’s Reach: Devil Reef – 15% Off

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412200/Cthulhus_Reach_Devil_Reef/

A minimalist 2D Platformer like no other! As David, you are given a slingshot-esque gift that you will have to use to conquer your colossus foes. Be there AND be square.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/346180/David/

Save the universe in Entropy Survivors, a bullet hell roguelike where you simultaneously control a powerful mech and a sharpshooting space frog.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2602030/Entropy_Survivors/

(P.S. Check out our newly released St. Patrick's Day update!)


🏡 Neighborhorde – 75% Off
Neighborhorde is a couch co-op shoot-em-up where you and your team of friends use toys as weapons and game-changing superpowers to try to survive the attacks of evil robots and zombie Abe Lincolns.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/446760/Neighborhorde/


💥 SPINGUN – 65% Off
SPINGUN is a "manic two-button arcade shooter". Two buttons. One spaceship. Zero chance to survive.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/548230/SPINGUN/



🛒 These deals won’t last forever—the sale ends March 20, 2025! Get your favorite First Break Labs games while they’re discounted and experience the thrill, horror, and chaos at a fraction of the price.

Howdy Neighbors!

Neighborhorde is at its core a "Couch Co-op" game. However, here's some game changing news:

You can now play Neighborhorde with your actual neighbor, or anyone in the world ONLINE, using Parsec!

The wizards of Parsec have made something truly magical, and you can use their free app to play Neighborhorde online. It's super easy to set up too!
[olist]
    Go to  parsecgaming.com and download the app.
    Launch the app and create an account.
    If you want to host the party, click "Add A Computer", and use your own computer or rent a cloud computer from Parsec. Then have a friend request to Co-play.
    If you want to join a friend who is hosting, find them with their Parsec username and request to Co-play.
    The host can run Neighborhorde, and the other players can join in as if their controllers were connected to the host's computer. MAGIC!
[/olist]
If you have any issues with Parsec, jump on over to their Discord here.

I thought it was too good to be true, but it really works quite well, and I hope it catches on for fans of indie couch games!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12179368/e47fafe772b10ff64cd12f5efcff2f8f5983e4b1.png

Cheers,
Andrew

Howdy Neighbors! Thanks for the awesome launch so far.

Be sure to leave a review, we'd really appreciate it. Also, keep on sending in your videos and suggestions, we love em!

It's been 9 days since launch, and we've still been hard at work on making Neighborhorde even better for you all to play. Thanks to feedback from the community, we're bringing you a quick update that'll improve many aspects of play.

-------------------------------------------

PATCH NOTES (v1.1)

New Features:
 
Player 1 can use Keyboard and Mouse, while Player 2 uses gamepad. Yay! (Must toggle this in the options)
 
Smarter friendly bot AI: High priority on reviving teammates, overall faster speed, faster decision to get back to Friendzone, more dashing and evasive movement when attacked.

Option for Auto Weapon Pickup when weaponless.
 
Balance/Polish:
 
Superpower Buffs: HIGH FEVER damage, PUSHY damage and knockback, RUDE AWAKENING bigger explosion, BEAT THE HEAT and ICE SLICER punching much more likely to effect, NIGHT LIGHT radius and heal rate, CHEST BUMP explosion radius and knockback, HOT FEET and SLIPPY SLIDE more projectiles, RING OF FIRE more likely, SUMMER LOVE bigger radius.

Improved mouse aiming, smoother and more consistent, along with an added aiming reticle on the ground when using mouse+kb controls.
 
Made EASY difficulty easier, more health (from 235hp to 255hp).
 
Adjusted shop prices for maps (Camp Woody 100 Tix, Cool School 200 Tix).
 
Made kite possible to be chosen earlier.
 
More time for low ammo indicator.
 
Made RC CHOPPER more visible.
 
Nerf NINJA damage slightly lower.
 
Bug Fixes:
 
Made "P1 use mouse+kb" part of the save/load functions

Made sure screenshots work with F12.

Optimized RING OF FIRE and RING OF ICE calculations.
 
Fixed “Kids Rule” and “Super Duper” achievements not unlocking on THE WALL.

-------------------------------------------

Well that's all for now, but don't worry; we've got lots of cool new stuff in the works! We'd also love to know what you'd like to see in the game. Keep the suggestions coming, we're all ears. Have an idea for a new weapon/enemy/superpower/map/character/etc? We'd love to hear it!

Cheers,
Andrew

notes.title: Neighborhorde Launching June 6th!
notes.content:
https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5313f4d2e4b02a8d2512ef9d/t/591b572ec534a54e1e93c821/1494964768903/Neighborhorde+Promo

That's right. The moment we've been waiting for is finally arriving. 21 days from now, you and your friends will be bashing evil hordes of wizards and lunchladies with your wooden swords and bottle rockets.

Neighborhorde is launching on June 6th, 2017, on Steam (PC & Mac) with a regular price of $4.99. 

We're also having a launch sale on all platforms for 20% OFF! That's a sale price of $3.99 at release until June 19th.

That's like $1 per player!

PRESS KIT

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12179368/4d1ec87cbc397cb58e021e208f4743417f91771b.png 	                                          

We've been working super hard over the past 2 years to bring this game to you all, and we're super proud of what we've created.

21 days from when I'm writing this, Neighborhorde will be out. Help us spread the word!

Stay tuned for more!

Cheers,
Andrew

notes.title: Quick Update:
notes.content: Sorry for the hiatus! Neighborhorde is still alive, although a few bugs with the software have had us stuck for months. Fortunately, I think we've finally beat those bugs and are able to finish development very soon. However, we are also planning on releasing on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, which is a fairly tricky and lengthy process. I'll post more when I have more knowledge, but for now wish us luck in finishing this thing! We're looking forward to seeing you all in Neighborville. :)
